hebrewText: כִּ֤י דָמָ/הּ֙ בְּ/תוֹכָ֣/הּ הָיָ֔ה עַל צְחִ֥יחַ סֶ֖לַע שָׂמָ֑תְ/הוּ לֹ֤א שְׁפָכַ֨תְ/הוּ֙ עַל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ לְ/כַסּ֥וֹת עָלָ֖י/ו עָפָֽר

tokens.bdb: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.kjv: and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured(-ly), + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-) though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet.

tokens.bdb: blood (as that which when shed causes death) of man or an animal; by analogy, the juice of the grape; figuratively (especially in the plural) bloodshed (i.e. drops of blood)

tokens.kjv: among(-st), [idiom] between, half, [idiom] (there-, where-), in(-to), middle, mid(-night), midst (among), [idiom] out (of), [idiom] through, [idiom] with(-in).

tokens.bdb: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)

tokens.bdb: glaring, i.e. exposed to the bright sun
a craggy rock, literally or figuratively (a fortress)
to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)
